The '''''Empty Boot''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that once operated near [[Drall (planet)|Drall]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] to recover a shipment of [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]].
